name: shoe-care-studio
description: A local-first, accessibility-oriented pre-production leather shoe-care reference with fail-closed care semantics and a procedural Three.js renderer.

scripts.test:footwear: node tools/assemble-footwear-register.mjs --check && node --import tsx --test tests/footwear-*.test.ts tests/footwear-*.test.tsx
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
